description: This is an HTML file implementing a web-based database viewer interface. It includes embedded CSS styles and JavaScript code that handles loading databases, tables, and data, as well as user interactions like refreshing, expanding cells, and selecting tables.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting selections and UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML table from data and inserts into the container.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cell content, handling object and long string expansion.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses a cell to show full content.
